2: 进入沼泽后，先检查入口附近的竖向通道。沿带水泡的竖井落到下层，再打开地图核对上下通道，不要漏掉下层支路。
Check the vertical passage near the bog entrance. Drop through the shaft with bubbles, then consult the map for lower branches before continuing horizontally.
从草地平台右侧跳下，在底部靠近罐子的位置继续探索并检查发光拾取物。上方还有敌人，先观察落脚点再下落。
Drop from the right edge of the grassy platform and inspect the glowing pickup near the pot below. An enemy remains above, so check your landing first.
在有巨大车轮背景的平台上与伊尔达交谈。看完关于上方宫殿的对话后，再检查周围通道。
Speak with Ilda on the platform with large wagon wheels in the background. Finish her dialogue about the palace above, then inspect the surrounding passages.
在窄竖井向上弹起时，可以取得饰物点。用截图中的小地图对照房间位置，检查这条上行支路。
A trinket-slot pickup lies along the upward rebound through the narrow shaft. Use the accompanying minimap to locate the room and inspect this upward branch.
进入砖墙计时挑战房间，先观察平台距离与地面尖刺。选择安全落脚点，再连续跳跃推进。
In the brick-walled timed challenge, check platform spacing and floor spikes. Choose safe landings before continuing through the jumps.
返回沼泽时，检查狭窄通道中央小平台上的发光拾取物。留意顶壁高度，站稳后再跳向下一处平台。
On returning to the bog, check the glowing pickup on the small platform in the narrow passage. Watch the low ceiling and establish a safe landing before moving onward.
在营地区域再次与坐在篝火旁的伊尔达交谈。探索路线上的对话与营地对话位于不同节点，两处都可以查看。
Speak with Ilda again beside the campsite fire. Her roadside conversation and campfire conversation occur at separate locations; check both.
打开地图，对照浅黄色沼泽房间、右侧蓝色区域与人物位置。回查横向通道和向上的支路；黑色部分仍未探索。
Consult the map for pale-yellow bog rooms, the blue area to the right and the player marker. Recheck horizontal passages and upward branches; black space remains unexplored.
战斗中留意移入场内的大头骨。观察其移动方向，给自己留出横向躲避空间，不要只盯着主角附近的小目标。
Watch the large skull moving into the arena. Track its direction and preserve room to dodge sideways instead of focusing only on nearby targets.
地面头骨、上方虫群和右侧飞来的圆形目标会同时构成威胁。移动前一起检查地面与头顶，避免被上下夹击。
The grounded skull, overhead swarm and round attacks from the right can threaten you together. Check the ground and space above before repositioning.
战后在巢状平台完成攀爬教学：贴墙按住跳跃即可攀爬。体力有限，站在坚实地面会恢复；途中应寻找可站立的平台。
Complete the climbing tutorial at the nest platform after the fight. Hold jump against a wall to climb; stamina is limited and recovers on solid ground, so plan stops on stable platforms.
返回紫色帐篷保存游戏。利用新获得的攀爬能力，回查此前难以到达的高墙和上层支路。
Return to the purple tent and save. Use Climb to revisit previously inaccessible high walls and upper branches.
3: 进入带管道的纵向水道后，先检查左侧凹槽和小平台。找到安全落脚点，再继续向下探索。
At the vertical channel with pipes, inspect the left-hand recess and small platform first. Establish a safe landing before descending farther.
台阶附近的持锤敌人会举锤攻击。利用上下层平台保持距离，等动作后再接近，不要在窄平台上盲目换血。
Watch the hammer enemy's raised-hammer attack near the steps. Use platforms at different heights to maintain distance and approach after the action rather than trading hits on a narrow ledge.
在带蜡烛的水平平台上与柳儿交谈。先看完对话，再继续检查附近房间。
Speak with Liuer on the horizontal platform lined with candles. Finish the conversation before exploring nearby rooms.
气流房间底部有尖刺，中间有窄平台。先辨认安全落脚点；取得乘风能力前，继续推进教学节点，不要直接硬跳高处。
The airflow room has floor spikes and a narrow intermediate platform. Identify a safe landing; before obtaining Wind Ride, progress to the tutorial node rather than forcing the high jump.
完成巢状平台教学后，可利用竖向气流上升。结合两侧平台调整方向，乘风移动需要对应的气流。
After the nest-platform tutorial, ride the vertical updraft. Use platforms on both sides to adjust direction; Wind Ride requires airflow.
检查气流井中央小平台旁的发光拾取物。周围平台高度不同，先处理附近威胁，再上下移动。
Inspect the glowing pickup beside the small central platform in the airflow shaft. Deal with nearby threats before moving between ledges at different heights.
在左右有高台、中间有横板的房间回查支路。下层有持锤敌人，先站稳上层平台，再决定是否下落。
Recheck branches in the room with high ledges on both sides and a central platform. A hammer enemy remains below; establish an upper landing before dropping down.
紫色帐篷商店可购买第二个油瓶。这里适合作为战前补给点，检查资源后再继续前进。
Buy a second oil bottle at the purple-tent shop. Use this as a preparation stop and check supplies before the next encounter.
竖井战斗中，横板上下两侧都有带刺球状目标。换位前一起观察上下空间，避免只关注脚下平台。
Spiked round targets threaten both sides of the combat platform in the shaft. Check above and below before repositioning.
战斗后沿带管道的低顶通道前进。留意右侧小型角色，并用地图检查通道尽头的连接。
After the encounter, follow the low-ceilinged pipe passage. Notice the small figures to the right and check the exit connection on the map.
4: 吊钟右侧有虚线轮廓平台，地面和侧壁布满尖刺。先观察机关与平台变化，再安排穿越路线，不要直接踩向轮廓位置。
Outlined platforms sit to the right of the hanging bell, with spikes on the floor and wall. Inspect the mechanism and platform changes before crossing; an outline is not necessarily a solid surface.
打开局部地图，检查浅色区域内的分叉和左侧红色区域连接。人物标记在右端，可结合附近斜挂的平台定位。
Check the local map's pale-coloured branches and connection to the red area on the left. Locate the player marker at the right-hand end using the nearby slanted platforms.
经过有王冠装饰的木台时，与报幕员交谈。台上吊着笼子，看完对话后再检查舞台两侧。
Speak with the announcer at the crown-decorated wooden stage. A cage hangs above; finish the conversation before checking either side of the stage.
回到吊笼木架，与埃格伯特交谈。两个吊笼里的角色不同，分别查看对话与周围通道。
Return to the cage frame and speak with Egbert. The characters in the two hanging cages differ; inspect their conversations and nearby passages separately.
低矮通道里有地面目标和两只飞行敌人。先清理空中威胁，再接近地面目标，并留出走位空间。
The low passage contains a ground target and two flying enemies. Clear the airborne threats first, then approach the ground target while preserving room to move.
沿墓碑和阶梯平台之间移动，检查高台侧面与下方支路。跳跃前留意天花板，低顶通道不能直接向上攀出。
Move between the graves and stepped platforms, checking ledge sides and lower branches. Watch the ceiling before jumping out of a low passage.
回到王冠舞台时，台前出现巨大的怪物形态。完成初次报幕与吊笼对话后，再继续这段战斗路线。
A large transformed creature appears in front of the crown-decorated stage on a later visit. Follow this combat segment after the initial announcement and cage conversations.
舞台中央木板是主要落脚处，两侧地面有尖刺。敌人会放出红色球状攻击，先观察接近身体的弹幕，再寻找输出空档。
Use the central stage board while spikes cover the ground on both sides. Watch the large enemy's red round attacks and look for an opening before dealing damage.
5: 从城堡内的紫色帐篷开始，先保存游戏。以帐篷为回程节点，再探索周围房间分支。
Save at the purple tent inside the castle. Use it as a return point while exploring the surrounding room branches.
低顶房间上方有被石头遮住的收集物。检查地面开关或可互动机关，再观察上方路线是否改变。
A collectible above the low-ceilinged room is blocked by stone. Inspect the ground switch or other mechanism, then check for changes to the upper route.
计时挑战沿两侧有尖刺的窄竖井上升。利用左侧可用的安全墙段攀爬，不要只盯计时器而忽略侧壁。
The timed challenge climbs a narrow shaft with spikes on both walls. Use the available safe sections on the left and watch the spikes rather than focusing only on the timer.
链条上吊着木舟形目标，周围有蓝色瓶状投射物。观察吊挂物与投射方向，留出横向移动空间。
A wooden boat-shaped target hangs from a chain with blue bottle-shaped projectiles nearby. Watch its movement and projectile direction while keeping horizontal space.
与拾荒者交谈，他提到忙完后要去码头找姐姐。看完当前对话，再检查尚未探索的房间。
Speak with Looter, who plans to visit the docks to find his sister after finishing here. Complete the conversation and inspect remaining rooms.
链条机关房间左上方有发光书页，左墙和突出平台带刺。先从安全高台判断距离，再绕开刺面接近书页。
A glowing story page lies high to the left in the chain-mechanism room. Judge the jump from a safe ledge and avoid spikes on the wall and projecting platform.
回到草地平台和低顶房间，检查左侧平台旁的绿色拾取物。对照小地图回查平台下缘与附近支路。
Return to the grassy platform beneath the low ceiling and check the green pickup beside the left ledge. Compare the minimap with lower edges and nearby branches.
月光房间的上层平台有尖刺，下层地面可以连续通行。先沿下层检查出口，再考虑高处路线。
In the moonlit room, spikes cover the upper platform while the lower floor provides a continuous route. Check the lower exit before exploring the high branch.
水面石碑旁有关于被遗忘诅咒的剧情对话。看完对话后，再继续检查附近出口。
Read the dialogue beside the waterside gravestone about a long-forgotten curse. Finish it before inspecting nearby exits.
到达巢状平台后，与发光教学物互动。进入练习空间，按游戏内提示完成操作。
Interact with the glowing tutorial object on the nest platform. Enter the practice space and follow the in-game instructions.
6: 回访墓谷的吊钟机关，检查高处透明平台如何连接左右地形。先完成这段回访，再向码头方向继续探索。
Revisit the Graven Valley bell and inspect how the high transparent platform links the terrain. Complete this return visit before heading toward the docks.
从此前反锁通道的另一侧继续前进。对照小地图检查斜向木板、小平台和下层支路，再向上前往码头。
Continue from the opposite side of the previously locked passage. Check the slanted boards, small platforms and lower branch on the minimap before climbing toward the docks.
码头有木制高台、阶梯和较大的上下落差。逐段跨越平台，跳跃前检查目标平台的侧壁尖刺。
The docks contain wooden platforms, stepped ledges and substantial vertical drops. Cross them in stages, checking side-wall spikes before jumping.
在带圆窗和救生圈的房间与巴吉船长交谈。看完关于失踪船员的对话，再探索码头分支。
Speak with captain Barge in the room with a round window and life rings. Finish his dialogue about missing crew members before exploring docks branches.
吊网与刺球交错排列，上下都有危险物。沿空隙跳向安全平台，接近高处拾取物前先规划回程。
Hanging nets alternate with spiked balls, with hazards above and below. Move through the gaps to safe platforms and plan a return route before reaching high pickups.
在木台上的紫色帐篷保存游戏并检查补给。以这里为回程节点，继续探索已经走通的分支。
Save and check supplies at the purple tent on the wooden platform. Use it as a return point while exploring connected branches.
从上方跨越悬浮刺板，辨认安全落脚面。竖板侧面与下方地面都有尖刺，不要将所有边缘都当作可攀爬墙面。
Cross above the suspended spike boards and identify safe landing faces. Spikes cover board sides and the floor; not every edge is climbable.
地图中的浅紫色房间有多条上下分叉和紫色节点。按右端人物位置逐个回查相邻通道，黑色区域仍未探索。
The pale-purple docks map contains vertical branches and purple nodes. Recheck adjacent passages from the right-hand player marker; black areas remain unexplored.
回程再次经过吊网与刺球，从下方打开反锁连接。开启捷径后用较短路线回查剩余拾取点。
Return through the hanging nets and spiked balls, opening the locked connection from below. Use the shorter route to recheck remaining pickups.
水面木栈道的战斗中，敌人在左侧，远端地面有尖刺。利用可站立空间调整距离，并留意边缘和后续攻击。
During combat on the waterside walkway, the enemy is to the left and spikes lie farther along. Use the walkable space to adjust distance while watching edges and follow-up attacks.
战斗后倒地角色开始对话，场景转入剧情。看完战后对白，再继续探索。
A fallen character begins speaking after the fight and the scene transitions into a story event. Finish the post-battle dialogue before continuing.
回到带圆窗与救生圈的房间，再次与巴吉交谈。推进船员支线时，记得检查这个回访节点。
Return to the room with the round window and life rings and speak with Barge again. Check this revisit point while following the crew storyline.
7: 进入深渊之前，先在码头紫色帐篷保存并补买油瓶。检查补给后再转入水下探索。
Before entering the deep, save and buy another oil bottle at the docks' purple tent. Check supplies before starting the underwater section.
驾驶带照明的球形载具探索水下通道。鱼形敌人和高低差会影响通行，先观察出口与敌人方向，再通过窄口。
Explore underwater in the spherical vessel with its headlight. Watch fish-like enemies and changes in elevation before crossing narrow openings.
调整载具方向时，同时观察前方洞壁、照明范围和小地图。具体按键以自己的游戏设置为准。
Check the wall ahead, headlight range and minimap while adjusting the vessel's direction. Use the control bindings in your own game settings.
带尖刺的水下侧道有饰物点。先辨认狭窄入口，取得后留出转向空间，避开斜向尖刺和底部刺区。
A trinket-slot pickup lies in the spiked underwater side passage. Identify the narrow entrance and allow room to turn when leaving, avoiding diagonal wall spikes and the spiked floor.
低处横向水道向右上方转入阶梯状通道。先核对小地图上的向上连接，再调整载具方向。
The low horizontal channel turns toward a stepped passage above and to the right. Check the upward connection on the minimap before redirecting the vessel.
上升水道下缘的侧边平台旁有发光拾取物。检查左右凹槽，不要只沿主竖井直上。
A glowing pickup sits beside a ledge near the lower end of the ascending channel. Inspect side recesses rather than travelling straight up the main shaft.
带刺球与竖向水流的房间，上方拾取点暂时无法抵达。先在地图标记，再沿当前可通行的路线继续。
The upper pickup in the room with a spiked ball and vertical flow is not yet reachable. Mark it on the map and continue along accessible routes.
经过巨型头骨地标时，沿左侧水道前进。用小地图判断房间连接，检查通道上下缘的出口。
Follow the passage to the left of the giant skull landmark. Use the minimap to identify room connections and inspect exits above and below.
离开水下段后，进入徒步战斗房间。敌人从左上方出现并放出长矛式投射物，留意上方来袭方向，预留躲避空间。
After the underwater section, continue into combat on foot. Watch the enemy entering from the upper-left and spear-shaped projectiles, leaving space to dodge incoming attacks.
敌人落地时，头顶和右侧仍有红色投射物。先确认弹幕落点，再利用敌人停顿靠近输出。
Red projectiles remain overhead and to the right when the enemy lands. Check their landing positions, then approach during the enemy's pause.
战后在篝火旁与巴吉及船员交谈。看完这一段剧情，再继续后续任务。
Speak with Barge and the crew beside the campfire after combat. Finish this story segment before continuing the quest.
